## Access to candidate documents (FR-F3)

Does this change give a platform staff role (administrator, verification reviewer, Trust and Safety administrator) any way to read, list, count, open or download candidate documents: a policy, a function, a storage rule, a page or a log? If yes, it is merged only with all three of these:

- [ ] a decision record in docs/adr that names the need
- [ ] a named legal basis
- [ ] candidate-visible logging: every access writes audit.document_access_log with the accessor, and the candidate sees it in v_my_document_access_log

If no, write "No staff access" here.
